login.title: Welcome back
register.title: Create your account
register.error: Could not create your account. Try a different email.
dashboard.subtitle: You are signed in. Your workspaces will appear here in Session 4.
dashboard.empty: You don't have a workspace yet. Create your first one to get started.
workspace.title: Create your first workspace
workspace.subtitle: A workspace is where you enter and trace your business transactions.
workspace.name: Workspace name
workspace.demoHint: Start with a pre-filled demo workspace so you can explore right away.
workspace.error: Could not create the workspace. Please try again.
ws.newTransactionDesc: Add a new transaction and post it to the ledger.
ws.journalDesc: Every posted transaction, line by line, oldest first.
ws.ledgerDesc: One account at a time — opening, movements, running balance.
ws.trialBalanceDesc: Every account's opening balance, movement and closing balance at once — debits must always equal credits.
coa.title: Chart of Accounts
coa.demoNotice: Illustrative demo data — replace with a reviewed/licensed official chart before any real production or compliance use.
coa.demoNoticeOhada: Real SYSCOHADA structure (2017 révisé Acte Uniforme) — this is a representative subset, not the full ~900-line official list. Verify before any compliance use.
coa.demoNoticeIfrs: IFRS has no mandated chart of accounts (IAS 1). This is an editable starting template — accounts have no numbers.
coa.demoNoticeLegacy: Legacy Session 5 illustrative data — consider reseating this workspace with the framework-standard chart.
ws.newTransactionDesc: Describe what happened, pick accounts, and post a balanced entry.
ws.journalDesc: Every posted transaction, line by line — in the order it was posted.
ws.cashbookDesc: Cash and bank movements only, filtered from your posted transactions.
ws.accountsDesc: Browse your accounts grouped by class, and add or edit your own.
ws.ledgerDesc: Every posted movement of one account, with opening, running and closing balances.
tx.title: New transaction
tx.description: What happened? (say it in plain words)
tx.descriptionHint: One plain sentence about the event — we'll use it as the entry's description in the journal.
tx.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. I sold goods for 50 000 FCFA in cash
tx.unbalanced: Not yet balanced — total debits must equal total credits
tx.postHint: Add a description and balanced debit/credit lines to enable posting.
tx.balanceVerified: Balance verified: total debits = total credits.
tx.whatItMeans: What this means for your accounts
tx.noAccounts: No accounts available. Create one in the Chart of Accounts first.
tx.errDescription: Please describe what happened — add a plain-language description.
tx.errAccount: Choose an account for this line.
tx.errAmount: Enter an amount (debit or credit) for this line.
tx.errBothSides: Each line needs either a debit or a credit amount — not both.
tx.errUnbalanced: Not yet balanced — total debits must equal total credits.
journal.title: Journal
journal.subtitle: Every posted transaction, line by line, oldest first. Date is when it was actually posted.
journal.referenceHint: References look like TX-0012 — digits are matched by entry number.
journal.empty: No posted transactions match these filters.
ledger.title: General ledger
ledger.otherAccounts: All other accounts (most recently used first)
ledger.pickFirst: Select an account above to see its general ledger.
ledger.noActivity: No posted activity for this account in the selected period.
cashbook.title: Cash Book
cashbook.subtitle: Choose a cash-only or cash-and-bank cash book.
bp.title: Business Profile
bp.subtitle: Company details used on official documents and reports (address, RCCM, tax ID, fiscal year). They appear on reports only when filled in.
bp.mandatorySubtitle: One last step before your workspace is ready. Every workspace has a location and a fiscal year — registration numbers only if you have a registered business.
bp.taxIdPlaceholder: e.g. NIU: M012345678901X (Cameroon) · NINEA (Senegal) · IFU (Benin/Togo/Burkina Faso/Niger) — use whatever your country calls it
bp.fiscalPlaceholder: Select the month your fiscal year starts…
bp.fiscalYearHint: Affects period calculations: the trial balance's opening/movement split runs from this month instead of January. Default: January (calendar year).
bp.learner: I don't have a registered business yet (I'm using this to learn)
bp.learnerNote: RCCM and tax ID are not required for you. You can add them later from Business profile once your business is registered.
bp.error: Could not save the business profile.
bp.banner: This workspace's business profile is incomplete. Completing it makes your reports ready for official documents — you can keep working meanwhile.
bp.identityType: How will you use this workspace?
bp.identityLearnerDesc: Registrars' numbers aren't needed for learning. Your workspace still needs a country, an address and a fiscal year.
bp.identityUnregistered: I run a business that isn't formally registered yet
bp.identityUnregisteredDesc: Pick a legal form if you have one; RCCM/tax ID can be added later.
bp.identityRegisteredDesc: RCCM number and tax ID are required for official reports.
bp.legalFormNaDesc: For personal or learning use; no business form applies.
bp.legalFormNaHint: Not applicable — personal/learning use. You can still pick a real form if you already have one in mind.
bp.basisAccrualHint: Income and expenses are recorded when they are earned or incurred (standard for most businesses).
bp.basisCashHint: Income and expenses are recorded only when money actually moves.
bp.basisInfoNote: Informational only: this setting does not change how transactions are posted or reported.
bp.description: Briefly describe your business or organization (optional)
bp.descPlaceholder: e.g. A small shop in Douala selling building materials to local contractors
tb.title: Trial balance
tb.subtitle: Every account's opening balance, period movement and closing balance. Total debits must equal total credits.
tb.fromHint: Leave blank to include everything from day one.
tb.empty: No posted transactions in the selected period.
tb.unbalancedHint: Contact support — this should not happen for valid double-entry transactions.
txn.reverseConfirm: Reversing posts a NEW mirror entry with debits and credits swapped, cancelling the original out. The original entry stays in your books untouched and is marked as reversed. Continue?
txn.reverseSuccess: Reversal posted. The new mirror entry cancels the original — together their net effect on balances is zero.
report.title: Report
ws.financialStatementsDesc: The income statement and the balance sheet, built from your posted entries.
fs.title: Financial statements
fs.empty: Nothing to show yet — post some transactions first.
fs.summaryIncomeProfit: You received {revenue} of revenue and spent {expenses} this period — a profit of {result}.
fs.summaryIncomeLoss: You received {revenue} of revenue and spent {expenses} this period — a loss of {result}.
fs.summaryPosition: Your business owns {assets}, owes {liabilities}, and has {equity} invested in it.
fs.summaryNote: These numbers come straight from your posted entries — the detailed statement is below.
fs.resultOfPeriod: Result of the period (not yet transferred to equity)
fs.totalEquityAndResult: Total equity including the period result
fs.balanceCheckWithResult: Balanced once the period result is included: assets = liabilities + equity + result (the result is not yet booked to equity — no closing entries have been posted).
fs.balanceCheckBad: Unbalanced — report an issue. This should not happen for valid double-entry transactions.
